invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object and not null given its construction method.
The write statuses returned in the metadata should not be null after a write operation.
instantTime parameter is required by downstream executor and should not be null at return.
The input list of HoodieRecords should not be null as it is required by the insert logic.
context must be non-null because it is needed for the action executor.
